fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-html, no NewsArticle ld+json exists on this site -- fields come from <meta> tags and HTML) carry headline/articleBody-style fields; latest-mode records (S2-sitemap, monthly Google News sitemap shard, no RSS feed exists) carry title/link-style fields.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-html, S2-sitemap).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the <h1 class="title"> element (meta tags as fallback).

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article description, from the <meta name="description"> tag.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description:
Full article text, joined from direct-child

/

/

/
tags of each div.con-text block.

author.title: Author
author.description: Per-article byline/wire-source tag from <h5 class="title"> (e.g. "QNA", "AFP", "The Peninsula").

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher/organisation name from the article:author meta tag (upstream labels its own org name this way, not a personal byline).

category.title: Category
category.description: Main section name from the breadcrumb's first link, e.g. "Qatar", "World".

subcategory.title: Subcategory
subcategory.description: Subsection name from the breadcrumb's second link, e.g. "General", "Europe".

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: Publish timestamp as given by the datePublished/article:published_time meta tags (Doha local time, no explicit UTC offset in the raw value).

dateModified.title: Date modified
dateModified.description: Last-modified timestamp as given by the dateModified/article:modified_time meta tags.

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image URL from the og:image meta tag.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode sitemap entry (news:title).

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL from the sitemap entry (loc).

pubDate.title: Publish date
pubDate.description: ISO 8601 publish timestamp from the sitemap entry (news:publication_date).

lastmod.title: Last modified
lastmod.description: ISO 8601 last-modified timestamp from the sitemap entry (lastmod).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
